purpose: Prove the selected source SQL endpoint sees the API default connection's live backend before a separately reviewed protected restore controller can be admitted. This narrow source prerequisite does not authorize a production invocation, restore or release.
requiredInvariants: IR-20 remains active; IR-21 and production acceptance remain locked.
No product, database, dependency, credential, existing workflow, review or merge-policy change.
Use the existing API default connection; accept no caller-supplied DSN.
Bind actual live backend identity using a fresh random transaction-local marker, not matching database names or copied metadata.
Keep source queries read-only and container-side execution independently bounded.
Unknown identity, missing proof, failed completion or runtime drift cannot emit successful binding.
Publish no raw database names, principals, connection strings, inspections or marker.
No restore, dump, migration, release, provider delivery, secret access or new production command entry point is added.
Synthetic and mocked-Prisma protocol tests are not real PostgreSQL or production evidence.
Run real PostgreSQL marker semantics only on bounded disposable GitHub-hosted fixtures; distinguish its psql API transport from the production Prisma/API image.
Actual independent exact-head review and all applicable substantive CI are required before a manual SHA-bound merge.
